tasks.name: חציון עליון
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 0; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b); return s[s.length>>1]; }
tasks.note: HELD-OUT (pickat). Sort, then index n>>1 (upper median); empty gives 0.

tasks.name: השני בגודלו (ממוין)
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return 0; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>b-a); return s[1]; }
tasks.note: HELD-OUT (pickat). Second largest; fewer than 2 elements gives 0.

tasks.name: הלפני-אחרון
tasks.note: HELD-OUT (pickat). Element before the last (unsorted); fewer than 2 gives 0.

tasks.name: האמצעי (לא ממוין)
tasks.note: HELD-OUT (pickat). Middle element of the unsorted list (lower middle); empty gives 0.

tasks.name: השלישי בקטנו
tasks.note: HELD-OUT (pickat). Third smallest; fewer than 3 gives 0.

tasks.name: רבעון תחתון
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 0; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b); return s[s.length>>2]; }
tasks.note: HELD-OUT (pickat). Sorted, index n>>2 (lower quartile); empty gives 0.

tasks.name: השלישי מהסוף
tasks.note: HELD-OUT (pickat). Third element from the end (unsorted); fewer than 3 gives 0.

tasks.name: שני-שלישים בממוין
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 0; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b); return s[Math.floor(2*(s.length-1)/3)]; }
tasks.note: HELD-OUT (pickat). Sorted, index floor(2(n-1)/3); empty gives 0. Position table not a single shelf tool.

tasks.name: הרביעי ברשימה
tasks.note: HELD-OUT (pickat). Fourth element of the unsorted list; fewer than 4 gives 0 (k=3 is not a shelf constant).

tasks.name: השלישי בגודלו
tasks.note: HELD-OUT (pickat). Third largest; fewer than 3 gives 0.

tasks.name: חציון הזוגיים
tasks.note: HELD-OUT (pickat). Lower median of the even values only (filter step + sort; k depends on the filtered length); none gives 0.
